demand_definition: current request per-layer read volume / own per-layer compute; held through compute and stall
supply_definition: real SSD service / complete compute_start(k) to compute_start(k+1) interval; display only clipped
right_hand_means: true physical warm-window means from input, never projected supply-curve area
IO_stall_background: exact supplied stall intervals clipped for display; grey background
curve_style: orange dashed demand, blue solid supply with uniform linewidth
regime_labels: input group labels follow OD per-disk demand classification; not a claim of identical Once instantaneous load
cross_request_warning: supply can serve the next request while demand describes the current request; direct b/B comparison invalid
visual_review_notes: Inspected final full-regime OD/Once 32-row comparison and underload OD single-policy 32-row figure; no label, legend, column or footer overlap found.
Orange dashed demand remains distinguishable beneath coincident thinner solid-blue supply, including underload rows. All blue segments use the same linewidth.
Grey intervals indicate exact supplied IO stall. True warm means are placed in a separate right-hand column; NPU id and measured utilization are placed on the left.
All titles identify input groups; annotation explains grouping follows OD load and policy-dependent progress may change requests active at a given time.
Footer explicitly warns that cross-request cycles read the next request and supply cannot be directly divided by current-request demand.
Shared linear y axes preserve all demand/supply peaks: full/semi 0-60 GiB/s and under 0-20 GiB/s; no values were clipped or shifted.
